title: perf(console): an app route draws the console's frame right after the session read, and the chrome no longer waits for the route's reads
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuXu8529KKMpkikFhpmiBwMt)_

Part of #35981

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no authorable metadata changes (Metadata-protocol: none)

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWwKdjqiYQSujUXhn7

## 维护者速读

- 用链接或刷新整页打开任何应用页（记录页、列表页等）时，登录状态一确认，整屏的「正在打开你的控制台…」就换成控制台的空框架：顶栏、侧栏（宽度和用户上次留下的一样）、和页面形状一样的灰色骨架。本地测量：整屏启动画面从约 1.1 秒提前到约 0.4 秒消失；把权限接口模拟成托管环境的 3 秒时，从约 3.8 秒提前到约 0.4 秒。
- 骨架里不出现应用名称、图标、任何菜单项或按钮：这些要等应用列表、权限和管理员判定回来才知道，所以「闪一下别的应用」「闪一下没权限的菜单」「误跳转」都不会发生，判定的输入和时机与改动前完全相同。
- 记录内容出现的时间不变（本地约 1.5 秒，模拟 3 秒权限时约 4.2 秒），没有变慢；本 PR 只改「等待时看到什么」。数据本身更早发出要动权限前置读取，另议。
- 出错时最坏情况是骨架和真实框架之间有一次位置跳动，可直接撤回；不改任何接口和返回格式。托管环境前后对比要等部署后才能测，卡片保持打开（本 PR 写 Part of），由座位安排。

## What changes

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ConsoleBootShell.tsx`:
  - `ConsoleBootShell`: the console chrome's frame with nothing in it. The real `AppShell` from `@object-ui/layout` (same sidebar primitive and route-slot classes as `ConsoleLayout`; since #36187, no top bar from 768 px up and grey blocks where the sidebar's head puts the app menu, the search and the bell and its foot the account; the 48 px top bar on a phone and on a docs page), `primeConsoleSidebarOpen` run before the sidebar provider reads its cookie (as `ConsoleLayout` does), grey blocks in the bar and the sidebar, and in the slot the skeleton of the route the URL names (`metadataReadsForAppRoute`). No text, no link, no button. It draws the shape the chrome will have on the route and width, from the same predicates `ConsoleLayout` reads (`showHeader={(phone || docsPage) && !recordPageOwnsTopBar}`) (moved to `layout/consoleRoutePaths.ts`, re-exported from `ConsoleLayout`): no sidebar on an app's docs pages (`isAppDocsPath`, #36000) and no top bar on a phone record page (`isRecordPagePath`, objectstack#28483). It carries `data-boot-splash` (it is still the boot wait) and `data-boot-shell`.
  - `ConsoleBootFallback`: the frame on an `/apps/:app/*` route once `useAuth()` has answered with a user; `LoadingScreen` while the session read is out, with no user, on every other route (`/home`, auth surfaces, `/forms/…`), and outside a router.
  - `RouteMetadataSkeleton` moved here from `AppContent.tsx`, with a `boot` flag that adds `data-boot-splash`.
- `ConsoleShell.tsx` `LoadingFallback` renders `ConsoleBootFallback`. That covers the gates between the session read and `AppContent`: `ConnectedShellInner` (adapter), `RequireOrganization` (organization list) and the console host's `ConsolePermissionsScope` (`ui/apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`, now `loadingFallback={<LoadingFallback />}`; its error fallback is unchanged).
- `AppContent.tsx`:
  - The readiness gate draws `ConsoleBootShell` instead of `LoadingScreen`, and holds only on the adapter, the app list, the admin verdict (objectui#5619) and the deployment flags (`/auth/config`). The flags are new to the gate: the chrome's navigation gates read them, and a navigation predicate naming a flag (`features.cloudManaged != true`) faults and withholds its entry while none are bound (objectui#12700). Before, the route's own reads made the chrome mount after that answer by timing only; with them off the gate, Live E2E UI caught the fault (`list-row-action-cel`), reproduced locally by holding `/auth/config` 2 s. The first-paint wait on the route's own buckets (`!firstPaintDone && !routeReadsSettled`, objectui#12809) is gone: the chrome mounts, and the route slot shows `RouteMetadataSkeleton` until `routeReadsSettled`, the path a later navigation already took.
  - The two access-verdict waits before the chrome (`appSurfaceAwaitsVerdict`, `requestedAppMissing`) draw the frame too.
  - The route slot's `Suspense` fallback is `RouteMetadataSkeleton … boot` instead of the full-screen `LoadingScreen` inside the chrome (measured locally: 0.2 s of logo splash inside the chrome while the record page's chunk resolved).
  - `firstRouteDrawn` (replaces `firstPaintDone`) keeps the first route skeleton's `data-boot-splash` until the route's reads have landed once.
- `RedirectWithSplash` paints `ConsoleBootFallback` instead of `LoadingScreen`, so a boot redirect out of a gate that was drawing the frame (`RequireOrganization` → `/organizations`, `AppContent` → home) still changes no pixels during its hand-off (objectui#6378).

Read first (risk order):
1. `AppContent.tsx`, the readiness gate and the route slot (`RouteMetadataSkeleton`, the `Suspense` fallback).
2. `ConsoleBootShell.tsx`, `RoutedBootFallback`'s conditions.
3. `ConsoleShell.tsx` `LoadingFallback`, `RedirectWithSplash.tsx`.

## Why

An `/apps/:app/*` open passed five gates in a row, each drawing the full-screen splash: `AuthGuard` (`get-session`), `ConnectedShellInner` (adapter), `RequireOrganization` (`organization/list`), `ConsolePermissionsScope` (`/auth/me/permissions`, more than 3 s server-side on the hosted environment, #35987), then `AppContent`'s gate (app list, admin verdict, the route's own reads until the first paint). Only the first decides whether there is a session. The others decide which app this is, which navigation exists and where to redirect, and the frame shows none of those.

What each guarantee rests on, unchanged:
- **No wrong-app flash**: the frame names no app. The chrome still mounts only once the app list is in and the URL's app is matched; `requestedAppMissing` and the access-verdict screens are unchanged.
- **No unauthorised-menu flash**: navigation entries come only from the real chrome (`UnifiedSidebar`, `AppHeader`), which still mounts after the permission answer and the admin verdict.
- **No redirect loop or wrong redirect**: the frame never navigates; the no-active-app redirect still waits for the admin verdict, and the organization redirects for their own inputs.
- **Boot-paint semantics** (objectui#12980, readiness waits): the frame and the first route skeleton carry `data-boot-splash`, so the chrome's deferred feeds (`sharedUserFeeds`), the locale list (`loadLocales`) and the e2e/smoke waits keyed on that marker wait for exactly what they waited for before.

What the chrome reads before the route's buckets land: `ConsoleLayout`/`AppHeader`/`CommandPalette` get the object list the route has so far (the scope's or none). The header's object crumb is absent until the object lands, as on any later navigation today. Nothing in the chrome decides from it.

## Verification

### Before/after, the same record page (local and throttled, not hosted)

`examples/app-showcase` (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, seeded admin), behind a local HTTP/2 TLS proxy (#35987's recipe), Chromium 1280×800, zh-CN, JS cached, DevTools throttling 300 ms RTT / 6 Mbps, 3 runs per row, full-page open of `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_project/record/<id>`. Seconds from navigation start. Paint milestones from a MutationObserver: full-screen splash gone (no `LoadingScreen` left and the pre-JS splash gone), frame drawn (`data-boot-shell`), chrome drawn (`console-route`), record shown (its name in the route slot). The second profile holds `/auth/me/permissions` 3 s in the proxy, a stand-in for the hosted server time (simulated, not measured hosted).

| Profile | | `get-session` answered | full-screen splash gone | chrome drawn | record shown |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 300 ms / 6 Mbps | before | 0.38 / 0.40 / 0.35 | 1.69 / 1.15 / 1.09 | 1.51 / 0.96 / 0.87 | 2.10 / 1.52 / 1.46 |
| | after | 0.44 / 0.35 / 0.36 | **0.69 / 0.37 / 0.37** (frame) | 1.19 / 0.81 / 0.82 | 1.89 / 1.50 / 1.52 |
| + permissions held 3 s | before | 0.47 / 0.45 / 0.35 | 4.03 / 3.87 / 3.78 | 3.79 / 3.62 / 3.57 | 4.40 / 4.25 / 4.16 |
| | after | 0.42 / 0.41 / 0.35 | **0.74 / 0.44 / 0.37** (frame) | 3.89 / 3.63 / 3.52 | 4.53 / 4.26 / 4.15 |

- The frame replaces the splash within about 20 ms of the session answer in runs 2 and 3 (run 1 of each row is the first open after the warm-up and starts its reads late), before `/meta/page` answers (0.73–1.10) and well before the permission answer.
- "Before" splash gone comes after "chrome drawn" because the chrome mounted with the full-screen `LoadingScreen` inside it while the record page's chunk resolved; after, that slot shows the record skeleton.
- Chrome drawn and record shown do not move beyond run noise: the record's data read still leaves after the permission answer and the record page's mount (`POST …/page` sent at the same times before and after). Moving that read earlier is a different change (a data read before the permission answer), not taken here.
- ⚠ Gap: the hosted environment is not reachable from this container, and an "after" there exists only once this is deployed. The hosted before/after (#35981's scope addition: segment timings before #35987 and after this PR, and `/api/v1/packages` off the boot path) is owed after deploy; the card stays open for it.

Screenshots after #36187 (`after2-1440-*`, `after2-375-*`: frame, then loaded) and, from the first round, (frame → chrome → record) at 1280×800 (sidebar folded by the window width, as the chrome folds it), 1600×900 (sidebar open, same width in frame and chrome) and iPhone 13, the raw runs (`*.json`, `summary.txt`), the measurement script and the proxy: `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35981/` in the project files.

### Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/ConsoleBootShell-35981.test.tsx` (new, 7 cases): the frame on an app route with a user, carrying `data-boot-splash`, the top bar and the route skeleton; `LoadingFallback` draws it; a boot redirect paints it at its first commit and then lands; the frame has no text and nothing to press; no sidebar on a docs page and no top bar on a phone record page, with the sidebar and the bar kept everywhere else; the splash while the session read is out, with no user, on `/home`, `/login`, `/forms/…`, bare `/apps`, and outside a router.
- `AppContent.splashCriticalPath-12809.test.tsx` (amended): before the member row answers, the frame and no chrome; after it, the chrome with the route skeleton carrying `data-boot-splash`; the splash marker leaves when the route draws, as before. The two CONTROL cases are unchanged and pass (a later skeleton is not the boot wait).
- Amended where the old splash was the expected frame: `AppContent.routeChunkPreload-12980` (case (a): the chrome is up under the route skeleton while the page's reads are out; the inside-the-chrome watcher counts the full-screen splash only, and case (b) now sees the route skeleton, not a splash, while the chunk loads), `bootRedirectCoverage` (the boot frame counts as full-viewport cover), and the `LoadingFallback` mock in `App.homePermissions-12700` and `FormPage.routePermissions-29187` (the permission scope's fallback). All four pass.
- Local run of `packages/app-shell/` and `apps/console/`: the first full run hit its 50-minute limit in this 4-core container after reaching those four reds and nothing else. The scoped rerun after the fixes (app-shell `console/`, `chrome/`, `layout/`, `hooks/`, and `apps/console/`): 892 files, 7992 tests, all pass. CI's Test UI shards carry the whole suite and are green on the head.
- `AppContent.splashCriticalPath-12809`: a new case holds `/auth/config` and pins frame-not-chrome until it answers (red with the gate line reverted). `AppContent.unresolvedAdmin-5619` (three cases, including the MUST NOT CHANGE one) now awaits the chrome, since the flags' answer is a promise even when the mock gives it at once; the admin verdict still adds no wait. `AppContent.emptyNavigationLanding-12079` gets a stable `getAuthConfig`, as `AuthProvider`'s `useCallback` gives, since a fresh one per render re-asks on every render.
- After merging `main` and the L1-b should-fixes: app-shell `console/`, `layout/`, `chrome/`: 465 files, 3659 tests, all pass; `pnpm console:build` green.
- `pnpm check:test-source-alias`: the amended boot-path test now mounts the chrome, which reaches `@objectstack/lint` lazily; it loads it at module top, as the gate asks. Green.
- `pnpm console:build` (runs `tsc` for app-shell and the console): green.
- ESLint on the changed files: no errors.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (changed files).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset (`.changeset/35981-app-route-boot-frame.md`, patch), and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the maintainer summary is in Chinese by the maintainer's standing rule).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.

Follow-up (not in this PR): the record's own data read waits for the permission answer and the record page's mount; starting it earlier would need its own card (it reads data before the permission answer arrives).
